title: Complexity analysis
learn: Big-O / Θ / Ω, common runtimes, time vs space, how to calculate (loops, nested loops, recursion), best/avg/worst, amortized
hook: Every interview answer ends with "what's the time and space complexity?" Getting it wrong, or not being able to explain *why*, sinks otherwise good solutions.

explain.prompt: Explain what Big-O notation means and walk through how you'd find the complexity of a function with a loop inside a loop.
keyPoints: Big-O describes how cost grows as input size n grows (upper bound, worst case by convention)
drop constants and smaller terms: 3n² + 5n → O(n²)
sequential blocks add, nested loops multiply
space complexity counts extra memory, including the recursion stack
a loop that halves the problem each step is O(log n)
